_comment: THUGPRO compatibility for the THAW level ports (tools/thaw_levels). Each entry is registered in README.md here (TP-1...). Online a level is known only by its load script's checksum (messages 0x46 / 0x33) and positions travel as world coordinates (0x23): these make our files agree with THUGPRO's own THAW ports. Read by tools/compat/compat.py; `thaw_levels.py convert --compat none` leaves all of it out.

thugpro_new._note: New in THUGPRO (in no source game): its meshes and collision, reshaped meshes, content nodes, scripts and host-option defaults - by reference only: each entry names THUGPRO's item and a CRC-32 of it; the converter reads the bytes from the THUGPRO install (--thugpro) and skips (with a warning) what is missing or differs. Entries in the differences files' shared form (compat.Entry: id, op add / set / remove, target {zone, kind, name}, why); left_out: what wasn't taken, and why. --no-thugpro-new leaves the whole section out.

Z_OI.why: a vehicle not there at the start (THUGPRO's scripts make it): our port makes only the cars there at the start - its model veh\veh_ferry\veh_ferry.mdl not needed either

the sky dome of THUGPRO's thaw_sky.scn.xbx (bundled in each level's scn.prx) - THAW's own TestLevel_Sky, which our port converts from THAW itself (thaw_sky: the same sector, 4 meshes of 18 / 50 / 18 / 18 vertices); not level content

port_changes._note: Our own changes to THAW's levels: neither THAW's data nor THUGPRO's. Applied whatever --compat (also none); --no-port-changes leaves out all but the `required` ones (the level needs them to load). op: add / set / remove; switch: the name tools/thaw_levels/thaw_levels.ts checks (portChange).

target.rule: every area with a <zone>_Zone_Origin node: nodes, particles, scene and collision moved by minus its Pos (whole sixteenths)

entries.why: keeps the areas near the origin (float precision, the network's +-16,384 position range); TP-2 / TP-3 adjust it for THUGPRO
THAW shows them only at night (its time-of-day scripts); our ports are lit as by day

target.rule: the sectors a node names as its LOD_Name (far-away copies), and their nodes (placeholders)

entries.why: THUG2 has no LOD switching for them: it would draw both copies

target.rule: LevelGeometry whose TriggerScript shatters it (The Mall's MA_BreakGlass...): the script made PlaySound HitGlassPane2x + Shatter + Kill, its faces non-collidable triggers (0x1150), its Type taken off (thaw_levels.breakableScripts)

entries.why: glass you skate through as in THAW; assumes ShatterAndDie is THAW-only - THUG2 has ShatterAndDie (SK4_Scripts.qb) and BloodSplat (bails.qb), and this drops MA_KillStickers (The Mall's 'closed / cerrado' sticker floats after the glass breaks): under audit, not changed here

target.rule: TrickObject / Cluster on every geometry node without a scene sector (nodes.stripMissingTrickObjects)

entries.why: ParseNodeArray (0x00588630) reads through the missing sector: a crash loading the level

target.rule: restarts over nothing (the shops' interiors) or over a kill zone: no network spawn types, no kill targets (nodes.groundRestarts)

entries.why: a player spawned there falls for ever or is killed at once

target.rule: collision trigger flags (0x40) on every object but kill zones, breakables and geometry whose TriggerScript we bring (thaw_levels.convertCol)

entries.why: THUG2 runs a trigger face's node's TriggerScript without checking it exists: a crash on a script we don't bring

target.rule: a material pass blending by the previous pass's alpha after another such pass (blend modes 12 / 13; thaw_levels.toThug2Material)

entries.why: THUG2's pixel shader (0x004DD2C0) doesn't assemble: the game crashed loading Santa Monica

target.rule: billboard sectors (SEC_BILLBOARD: every vertex at the pivot; thaw_levels.convertScene)

entries.why: THAW's shader spreads them to face the camera; their billboard data isn't converted, THUG2 can't draw them

target.rule: collision face flags 0x2000 / 0x4000 / 0x8000 and material pass flags THUG2 hasn't the data for (FACE_KEEP, PASS_KEEP); blend modes past 13 made 5

entries.why: not THUG2's meanings: THUG2 would read them as something else

target.rule: path followers, peds and cars marked AbsentInNetGames (nodes.netGameNodes)

entries.why: network games have no path manager or ped animations: they'd be created without them

target.rule: peds, cars, moving objects, particles and game-mode flags made THUG2's way (thaw_scripts.PortedNodes: THUG2's ped AI, Car_Generic01, Team_Flag...); goal / story / animal peds, cars not there at the start, objects without a sector left out

entries.why: THAW's components and their scripts don't exist in THUG2
